answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 23497 Country: Pakistan Title: I am a Male and My name is Rehmatullah. I have a problem that sometimes i discharges liquid from penis when I had a feeling of sex and drops of liquid comes out. This continues happens and I faces same situation more than one time in 5 to 10 mins. I have a question that whether I have to perform gushal after each discharge. Second thing that piece of cloth on which discharge dropped will be "paak" after washing that part only with water or need to change the cloth. Question: I am a Male and My name is Rehmatullah. I have a problem that sometimes i discharges liquid from penis when I had a feeling of sex and drops of liquid comes out. This continues happens and I faces same situation more than one time in 5 to 10 mins. I have a question that whether I have to perform gushal after each discharge. Second thing that piece of cloth on which discharge dropped will be "paak" after washing that part only with water or need to change the cloth. Answer ID: 23497 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1237/995/B=1431) If white liquid is discharged it is madhi (pre-seminal fluid). It will not make ghusl wajib. However it is impure. It is necessary to wash the place where it smears. If there is more ardour in lust and semen spurts with full lust and ardour and the penis gets loose, it is semen. Ghusl will be wajib in this state, also washing the place where it smears. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
